title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
description: The ultimate crossover fighting game featuring 80+ fighters from across gaming history. Learn combos, special moves, and advanced techniques for every character.
tips: Use short hop aerials (press jump briefly) for faster aerial attacks.
Shield (ZL/ZR) and grab (A + shield) are essential defensive tools.
Learn to DI (Directional Influence) by holding the stick away from the direction you're being launched.
Practice edge-guarding — go offstage to intercept recovering opponents.
Each character has a unique weight and fall speed that affects combos.
